rules.statement: A seller is not liable for selling a price-controlled article at an excessive price if the evidence shows that they were unaware of the under-weight and only handled the transaction to receive payment.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where A and B are charged with having jointly sold a price-controlled article in excess of the prescribed price by selling it under-weight, B is not liable to be convicted if the evidence shows that he was not aware that the article handed to the buyer by A was under-weight and that B was only called upon by A to take the money for the correct weight and to pay the balance to the purchaser. In such a case the principle of liability contained in section 35 of the Penal Code has no application."
